title: Customer Success Manager
description:
* Own the overall customer experience and customer success performance for the assigned city.
* Drive consistent customer engagement across the entire home interior journey, from onboarding to final handover and post-handover support.
* Ensure city-level adherence to customer communication standards, service protocols, and defined SLAs.
* Monitor customer experience across active projects and proactively identify accounts at risk of dissatisfaction.
* Establish structured review mechanisms to track customer concerns, project milestones, service gaps, and resolution progress.
* Act as the key escalation point for critical customer issues requiring city-level intervention.
* Drive improvement in customer satisfaction, NPS, CSAT, and overall customer confidence throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure customers receive timely and accurate updates on design approvals, material selections, execution progress, project timelines, and handover milestones.
* Identify customer pain points and implement city-specific initiatives to improve communication, transparency, and service delivery.
* Conduct periodic customer reviews and feedback analysis to understand expectations and service gaps.
* Build a customer-first culture across teams, ensuring that customer experience is treated as a shared business responsibility.
* Drive customer advocacy through improved service quality, positive reviews, referrals, and stronger brand trust.
* Own and drive resolution of high-priority customer escalations related to project delays, design changes, execution quality, material issues, cost variations, and communication gaps.
* Establish a structured escalation matrix with clear ownership, resolution timelines, and accountability.
* Coordinate with relevant functional heads to resolve customer concerns within agreed timelines.
* Conduct root cause analysis of recurring complaints and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Review aging escalations, pending customer commitments, and unresolved service requests through regular governance meetings.
* Partner with city-level Sales, Design, Project Management, Procurement, Site Execution, Quality, Finance, and After-Sales teams to ensure seamless customer delivery.
* Drive alignment between customer expectations, design commitments, commercial agreements, execution feasibility, and project timelines.
* Facilitate regular cross-functional reviews to identify project risks, customer dissatisfaction, and operational bottlenecks.
* Resolve interdepartmental dependencies that impact customer experience, project progress, or service commitments.
* Ensure customer feedback and concerns are communicated to the appropriate teams with clear action plans and closure timelines.
* Build strong working relationships with functional leaders to improve service delivery and city-level operational effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Experience in customer success
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Detail oriented and analytical
* Demonstrated ability to increase customer satisfaction

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description**
At Vamsi Art Printers Pvt. Ltd., we provide comprehensive, end-to-end printing solutions across Pre-Press, Press, and Post-Press stages. Our advanced in-house production facility manages everything from printing and binding to final delivery, allowing streamlined workflows and consistent quality. We operate to international standards, focusing on reliability, precision, and customer satisfaction. Clients benefit from our flexibility in order handling, fast turnaround times, and competitive pricing. This integrated approach makes Vamsi a trusted partner for diverse printing and packaging needs.

**Role Description**
The Customer Relationship Management Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This position is responsible for overseeing customer relationship strategies, managing key accounts, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction across the printing lifecycle. Day-to-day activities include tracking and analyzing customer data, segmenting markets, coordinating sales and service teams, and following up on orders from pre-press through delivery. The role involves managing CRM tools, monitoring customer feedback, and resolving issues in a timely and professional manner. The Manager will collaborate with production, sales, and logistics teams to align customer expectations with operational capabilities and support business growth.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Analytical Skills to interpret customer data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent Communication abilities to interact with clients, coordinate with internal teams, and present updates clearly.
* Sales and Market Segmentation skills to identify target customer groups, develop relationship strategies, and support revenue growth.
* Project Management capabilities to oversee customer projects, manage timelines, and ensure smooth delivery across pre-press, press, and post-press stages.
* Experience using CRM systems and basic proficiency in MS Office or similar productivity tools.
* Proven background in customer-facing roles, preferably in printing, manufacturing, or related industries.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field; relevant certifications in CRM or project management are an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad, prioritize multiple accounts, and maintain a customer-focused approach under tight deadlines.

title: Manager, Data Management
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading clinical research organization (CRO) that combines scientific expertise, operational excellence, and innovative technology to advance clinical development and improve patient outcomes. We partner with biopharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and academic institutions to design, execute, and manage clinical trials that bring life-changing therapies to patients worldwide. Our commitment to quality, integrity, and innovation makes us a trusted partner in clinical research.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Data Management Account Lead to drive operational excellence, strategic growth, and clinical program delivery. In this leadership position, you will oversee Data Management teams, serve as the primary client contact for complex, multi-study accounts, and manage critical business functions including resource planning, team development, and financial performance. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of clinical data management while building and mentoring high-performing global teams. You will work in a hybrid / on-site environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent delivery, quality governance, and exceptional client satisfaction. If you are a strategic leader with 10+ years of clinical data management and people management experience, and you are ready to make a significant impact on clinical development, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor Data Management teams, ensuring high-quality, timely project delivery, team development, and continuous performance improvement.
* Serve as the primary client and internal escalation point, driving account governance, resource planning, KPI management, and operational excellence across multiple studies and projects.
* Build and maintain strong client partnerships, support business growth initiatives, and contribute to bid pursuits and strategic account expansion.
* Oversee training programs, compliance activities, quality management, and adherence to ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and standard operating procedures.
* Manage resource allocation, utilization planning, recruitment strategy, financial performance, and risk mitigation across global Data Management teams.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration with clinical, regulatory, and project management teams to achieve account objectives and drive continuous process improvement.
* Provide Data Management expertise and strategic guidance on complex clinical programs, EDC platforms, and regulatory compliance matters.
* Proactively manage risks, issues, and contingency planning to ensure account profitability and client satisfaction.

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
We are looking for a strategic leader with proven expertise in clinical data management, team leadership, and account management. You are a decisive, results-oriented professional who excels in global, matrixed environments and thrives on building strong client relationships. You possess deep knowledge of EDC platforms, regulatory requirements, and clinical research operations. Your exceptional communication and presentation skills enable you to influence at all organizational levels. You are committed to operational excellence, process improvement, and developing talent. You bring a patient-focused mindset, integrity, and a passion for advancing clinical research.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in Clinical Data Management, project leadership, account management, and people management within the clinical research or pharmaceutical industry.
* Proven track record of leading global teams, managing complex client partnerships, and delivering complex clinical programs.
* Strong understanding of cross-functional clinical development processes, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Expertise in Data Management, EDC platforms (Rave, Inform, Medidata, etc.), and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Life Sciences or a related field.
* Professional certifications and industry affiliations (e.g., SOCRA, ACRP).
* Experience managing complex, multi-study clinical programs across therapeutic areas.
* Background in operational excellence, process optimization, and quality management.
* Experience with global team management and cross-functional collaboration in matrixed environments.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About SmartQ**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Key Account Manager?**

Are you passionate about operational efficiency and committed to fostering strong, value-driven client relationships, we invite you to explore this opportunity.

As a Key Account Manager at SmartQ, your primary goal will be to ensure client satisfaction, long-term retention, and sustainable growth across food court operations. Fostering, sustainable, and profitable relationships with key clients to maximize business opportunities lies at the heart of this role. In addition, a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of the clients and products will keep you functioning a cut above the rest.

**Key roles and responsibilities:**

**Client & Food Court Account Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for food court clients, mall management, and key stakeholders, ensuring high service standards and strong long-term partnerships.
* Lead regular client meetings, food committee discussions, and food court performance reviews to evaluate operations, sales, and customer experience, and to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive client satisfaction, retention, Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvement, and sustainable growth of food court accounts.
* Develop and present commercial proposals, partner onboarding plans, and business recommendations aligned with food court and client requirements.

**Food Court Operations Management**

* Oversee end-to-end food court operations, including multiple brand partners, daily service delivery, promotions, special events, pop-up counters, and special activations.
* Ensure food court operations are executed in line with SmartQ standards, SLAs, contractual terms, and applicable statutory regulations.
* Monitor food quality, service delivery, hygiene, safety, and customer experience consistently across all food court outlets.
* Ensure optimal utilization of resources, including manpower, utilities, infrastructure, and SmartQ technology platforms.
* Plan and manage manpower deployment and scheduling across the food court within approved budgets, aligned with footfall and sales trends.

**Brand Partner & Vendor Management**

* Manage end-to-end relationships with food court brand partners and vendors, including onboarding, negotiations, performance management, and compliance.
* Work closely with brand partners to improve sales performance, introduce new menu concepts, optimize pricing, and reduce food wastage.
* Ensure timely settlements, accurate documentation, compliance adherence, and effective resolution of operational or commercial issues.
* Support partners with operational insights, best practices, and improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and profitability.

**Financial & Commercial Management**

* Own food court–level P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and expense control in alignment with approved financial plans.
* Coordinate with the finance team to ensure accurate invoicing, revenue reconciliation, and timely payment follow-ups.
* Analyze food court sales, wastage, and cost metrics to implement revenue enhancement and cost-optimization initiatives.
* Drive upselling, cross-selling, and promotional opportunities across food court brands to maximize overall revenue.

**Compliance, Audits & HSEQ**

* Ensure strict adherence to HSEQ, food safety, hygiene, and statutory compliance standards across all food court outlets.
* Conduct and manage operational audits, QHSE audits, hygiene inspections, and partner compliance reviews.
* Prepare, implement, and track corrective action plans in coordination with the HSEQ team and food court partners for identified non-conformities.
* Maintain accurate documentation, compliance records, and audit reports for client, statutory, and internal reviews.

**Data Analytics & Reporting**

* Leverage data analytics to track food court performance, footfall-to-sales conversion, partner productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), MIS reports, dashboards, and client presentations focused on food court KPIs.
* Use insights from customer feedback, surveys, audits, and sales data to drive continuous improvement in service quality, partner performance, and menu mix.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and guide on-site food court operations teams, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and customer focus.
* Ensure team performance management, training, engagement, and retention across food court operations.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders—technology, finance, HSEQ, central operations, and sales—to ensure seamless food court management.
* Maintain continuous coordination with the technology team to ensure smooth functioning, adoption, and optimization of SmartQ food-tech platforms.

**Branding & Growth Initiatives**

* Support food court branding, marketing campaigns, festivals, and customer engagement initiatives at client locations.
* Communicate updates on new brand onboardings, menu launches, promotional offers, and operational enhancements to clients and stakeholders.
* Drive food court growth initiatives by identifying expansion opportunities, new partnerships, and experience-led improvements.

**Qualifications:**

* Overall, 6+ years of experience, with a minimum of 4 years in a similar role.
* Graduate/Diploma in Hotel Management or related discipline.
* Flexible and willing to take on various tasks to support team efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound knowledge and experience working with food, technology, and leveraging people.
* Results-oriented, accountable, and able to hold others accountable.
* Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment.
* Basic Food Hygiene certificate and knowledge of HSEQ standards.
* Self-motivated, agile, and able to adapt to a changing environment.

**Message from CEO:**

We've come to realize that we're not merely in the B2B Food service industry; we're in the business of 'Capturing Hearts.' We find ourselves in a unique position to turn ordinary, mundane corporate cafeterias into places of pure delight, where individuals can freely express themselves, find inspiration, and share happiness. Such a profound transformation opportunity is a rare gift, where the purpose of our enterprise transcends the ordinary. If this vision resonates with you, we invite you to join us in our mission to spread joy and happiness in a world weighed down by stress and pressure. Together, let's play our part in making this world a more beautiful place.

title: City Manager

As a City Manager at payrentz, you will play a hands-on role in growing our Hyderabad business, with a focus on business development, partnerships, and city operations. From building relationships, partnerships to generating leads, converting opportunities, and coordinating daily deliveries and service operations, you will be involved in the end-to-end execution of the city’s growth. * Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk
* AMS Delivery & Operations Management: Own end-to-end delivery of SAP FICO/MM/SD tax AMS engagements, including SLA governance, ticket triage and escalation across L1/L2/L3, incident and problem management, and driving continuous improvement in support processes and tooling

* People Development: Perform the role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

Additionally, Data Cloud is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. The Customer Success Manager leads a team of analysts responsible for helping customers and stakeholders realize greater value from business products. This role oversees day-to-day work, establishes priorities, monitors service quality and performance, and ensures complex issues are resolved through effective coordination with product teams and service providers. The manager translates customer and operational insights into practical product, process, staffing, and support improvements while developing analyst capability and maintaining stakeholder confidence.
  
  
This role is designed for a people leader who can balance operational delivery, coaching, escalation management, and strategic improvement across multiple priorities with limited supervision.
  
  
**Work you will do**
**Team Leadership and Work Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop Customer Success Product Analysts, setting clear expectations for quality, responsiveness, documentation, collaboration, and professional growth.
* Assign and prioritize work across products and analysts based on customer impact, risk, workload, expertise, and business priorities.
* Own and resolve tickets for complex audit applications.
* Monitor ticket queues, aging, service expectations, deliverables, and team capacity; address risks and rebalance resources as needed.
* Review analyst work for completeness, accuracy, judgment, and adherence to established processes, providing timely coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and ongoing capability development for the team.

**Operational Oversight and Escalation Management**

* Ensure product support issues are coordinated, monitored, documented, tracked, escalated, and resolved appropriately throughout their lifecycle.
* Serve as an escalation point for high-impact, complex, aging, or sensitive issues and coordinate response across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Development, DevOps, and service providers.
* Oversee readiness and response for outages, major incidents, product releases, and other events that may affect customers or support operations.
* Analyze team performance, ticket trends, recurring issues, root causes, and customer feedback to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Establish and maintain consistent support policies, standards, procedures, metrics, reporting, and knowledge-management practices.

**Stakeholder Partnership and Continuous Improvement**

* Build trusted relationships with customers, product leaders, service providers, and business stakeholders to align expectations and communicate priorities, risks, and outcomes.
* Translate operational data and analyst observations into recommendations for product, process, training, staffing, and customer-experience improvements.
* Represent the team in cross-functional planning, governance, readiness, and operational review forums.
* Sponsor and oversee improvement initiatives, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and sustained adoption.

**Decision-Making and Scope**
The role involves complex, varied work requiring independent judgment in prioritizing team activities, allocating resources, managing escalations, and balancing customer, product, operational, and employee needs. The manager makes recommendations and decisions that may affect multiple products, teams, service providers, and stakeholder groups, with timely escalation of significant risks or issues to leadership.
  
  
**The Team**
This team helps customers and stakeholders realize greater value from business products by resolving complex issues, analyzing product and support data, and identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes.

title: Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)
description:
**Job Description — Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

Y-Axis Overseas Careers · October 2026

**About Y-Axis and the opportunity**

Y-Axis is hiring one person to build and scale a new direct-to-consumer channel: service products that customers browse, choose and buy online without a sales call.

Y-Axis Overseas Careers is one of India's best-known migration and overseas career consultancies. For years our services have been sold through counsellors and branches. We are now packaging them as fixed-scope, fixed-price products, such as Work in Europe, Work in Germany and Work in Dubai for Nurses, sold through dedicated sales pages with a self-serve checkout.

Selling a service online is harder than selling a physical product. The buyer cannot touch it, the outcome is months away, and trust decides the sale. We need someone who has already solved that problem in a service business, not only in retail or FMCG e-commerce.

**The role: Growth Lead – D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**Experience**

6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, at least 3 in a service-based business

**Reports to**

Head of Digital / Business Head

**Works with**

Performance marketing, web development, design, CRM, content, sales and operations

**Role summary**

You will own the online sale of Y-Axis service products end to end: the product catalogue, the storefront and checkout, the traffic that reaches it, and the revenue it produces. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and do much of the work yourself, while directing existing marketing, web and CRM teams to execute.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and revenue ownership**

•    Own the growth plan and revenue target for online service products, with clear goals for customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS) and payback.

•    Decide which products, countries and customer segments to prioritise, using data on demand, margin and conversion.

•    Run a weekly growth review with clear owners, actions and results.

**Catalogue and offer**

•    Turn Y-Axis services into clear, buyable products: scope, inclusions, timelines, price points, tiers and bundles.

•    Write and maintain product pages, comparison tiles and FAQs that answer objections before they become sales calls.

•    Work with finance and operations on pricing, refunds, instalments and payment options.

**Storefront, checkout and conversion**

•    Own the sales-page and checkout journey on y-axis.com, from product tiles to payment and confirmation.

•    Brief design and development on new pages and features; write clear requirements and test before launch.

•    Build trust into every step: reviews, success stories, credentials, guarantees and a transparent process.

•    Run A/B tests on headlines, pricing display, trust signals, creatives and checkout steps.

**Acquisition and retention**

•    Direct paid acquisition across Google, Meta, YouTube and affiliates for product-led campaigns.

•    Work with SEO and content teams to build organic demand for each product page.

•    Set up abandoned-cart recovery and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp and SMS.

•    Design a hybrid path where high-intent buyers can move between self-serve checkout and a counsellor without friction.

•    Drive upsell and cross-sell to related services after the first purchase.

**Analytics and reporting**

•    Track the full funnel in GA4: sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts, payments and refunds.

•    Report weekly to leadership on revenue, conversion, CAC and drop-off points, with clear next actions.

**What we are looking for**

•    6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, with at least 3 in a service-based industry: edtech, immigration, study abroad, travel, healthcare, insurance, fintech or professional services.

•    Proven record of selling a service or digital product online, with numbers to show: revenue grown, conversion improved, CAC reduced.

•    Hands-on with GA4, tag management, A/B testing tools, landing-page builders and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar).

•    Has managed paid media budgets with a clear return.

•    Understands high-consideration buying: long decision cycles, trust building and the hand-off between digital and human sales.

•    Clear, persuasive product copywriting in English; can brief developers and designers precisely.

•    Comfortable working without a dedicated team, influencing other teams to get things done.

**Good to have**

•    Experience launching a D2C or self-serve channel inside a sales-led business.

•    Knowledge of international markets (Europe, Gulf, Canada, Australia) and NRI or migrant audiences.

•    Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and WhatsApp commerce.

**How we will measure success**

**Metric**

**What it tells us**

**Online service-product revenue vs target**

Is the channel delivering?

**Visit-to-purchase conversion rate**

Is the storefront doing its job?

**CAC and ROAS**

Is growth profitable?

**Average order value and cross-sell revenue**

Are tiers, bundles and upsells landing?

**Refund and cancellation rate**

Are we selling the right product to the right buyer?

**What we offer and how to apply**

**What we offer**

•    The chance to build a new revenue channel from the ground up, with leadership backing.

•    Direct impact on people's lives: every sale helps someone start an overseas career.

•    A strong brand, an established customer base and a large existing service catalogue to package and sell.

•    Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives.

**How to apply**

* Send your CV and a short note (no more than 300 words) to [email address]. In the note, tell us about one service or digital product you helped sell online: what you changed, and what happened to the numbers.

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

**What We Offer**

1. Fair, competitive compensation: Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability, and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.

2. Fast-track growth: You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.

3. Broad exposure: You see product, brand, events, retail, and operations, not one narrow slice.

4. Real ownership: Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.

2. You want a role with a fixed playbook already written.

3. You are not comfortable owning a P&L number.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
******About Salesforce******
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About Salesforce**
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success.
  
  
Success Architects, as part of Cloud Success, play a pivotal role in supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, ensuring scalability, security, and adherence to best practices. By assessing system performance, they help optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Additionally, they offer strategic insights into application lifecycle management, enabling customers to plan, develop, and evolve their Salesforce implementations effectively. Through deep expertise, Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment, aligning technology with business goals for long-term success.
  
  
The Success Architect collaborates closely with various teams across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term solutions for customers. They work with support engineers to resolve immediate technical challenges while identifying root causes to prevent future issues. Partnering with customer success managers, they ensure customers receive strategic guidance on best practices and long-term technology health. Additionally, they liaise with Salesforce product teams, surfacing recurring challenges and customer feedback to influence product improvements. By bridging the gap between customers, support, and product development, Success Architects help create sustainable solutions that enhance the overall Salesforce experience.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
As a Success Architect specializing in Service Cloud, you will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Service Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability and feature adoption.
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted Service Cloud SME within the broader Success Architect organization, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Service Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments, best practices and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems – Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of Service Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.
* Flexible to work in AMER hours (AMER EST/AMER PST)

****Basic Requirements:****

* Solution Design & Architecture
* 8+ years of experience in software, system or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
* Familiarity with industry- or vertical-specific solutions (preferred).
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making and advocate for best practices.
* High proficiency in English.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

**Desired Technical Skills:**

* Expertise in Service Cloud - Strong knowledge of Salesforce Service Cloud features
* Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.
* Data Management & Integration
* Proficient in designing and managing data models, relationships (lookup/master-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
* Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third-party connectors.
* Secure & Scalable Architecture
* Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
* Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Skilled in identifying and resolving common anti-patterns, including inefficient SOQL queries, improper bulk processing, excessive DML operations and suboptimal sharing and security model configurations.
* Salesforce Development
* Hands-on experience with APEX programming, Visualforce and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Ability to develop and optimize custom triggers, controllers, batch jobs and asynchronous processing.
* Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* System Integration & Extensibility
* Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event-driven architectures.
* Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.

****Certifications:****

* Required: Salesforce Admin, Salesforce Advanced Admin, Service Cloud Consultant
* Desired: Platform App Builder, Platform Developer 1, Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect)

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly Organized: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**
FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd. (ISFC) is an affordable housing finance company with a 12-year track record, operating across 15 states in India. The organization focuses on providing housing and small-ticket loans against property to primarily self-employed customers with informal income documentation. Its products include financing for new home purchases, home expansion and upgrades, construction on previously owned land, and loans against property. ISFC has built a hassle-free loan management process designed to serve middle- and lower-income segments and supports home ownership dreams with loans up to Rs 30 lakhs. The head office is located in Gurugram, Haryana.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Senior Relationship Manager role based in Hyderabad. The role involves acquiring and managing customers seeking affordable housing loans and loans against property, with a focus on self-employed and informally documented income profiles. The Senior Relationship Manager will meet prospective customers, understand their financial needs, explain product features, collect and verify documentation, and coordinate with credit and operations teams to ensure timely loan processing. Responsibilities include maintaining strong relationships with existing customers, monitoring repayment behavior, addressing service issues, and supporting portfolio quality and growth targets. The role also requires collaboration with local partners and internal stakeholders, regular field visits, and adherence to regulatory and company policies.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and customer service skills, including the ability to build trust with diverse customer segments.
* Experience in retail lending or housing finance, preferably handling self-employed or informal income customers.
* Ability to assess basic financial information, understand credit risk, and work with documentation relevant to housing loans and loans against property.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with proficiency in local language(s) and clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Comfort with field-based work, including regular customer visits, local market engagement, and on-site verification.
* Working knowledge of standard office and loan management systems; ability to learn new digital tools quickly.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; relevant experience in financial services or housing finance is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, attention to detail, and a strong focus on responsible lending and regulatory compliance.

Location
  
  
India
  
  
**About The Role**

**Partner Success Manager**
is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. * Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

* 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co-sell models.

description:

Job Details
  
  
******About Salesforce******
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. ****About Salesforce****
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
****About The Role****
The Senior Technical Consultant supports a work stream in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key stakeholders to achieve the vision while completing key deliverables. They serve as hands-on advisors — using strong solution, technical, and product knowledge, plus industry and consulting experience — to deliver customer ROI.
  
  
Senior Technical Consultants demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements, leading to successful delivery of enterprise desktop, cloud, and/or mobile solutions, including enterprise integrations via middleware tools and platforms. They lead the evaluation of options, present and educate customers/partners, and proactively manage risk areas through to resolution.
  
  
****Your Impact — Responsibilities****

* Become a highly certified and recognized Salesforce expert
* Help clients consistently meet/exceed goals and metrics
* Contribute to customer success through front- and back-end solution development and release management
* Deliver high client satisfaction (CSAT)
* Guide application/integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, functional and technical solution architecture & design, environment management, testing, and Salesforce Platform education
* Up-skill on AI Fluency and AI-Native delivery methodology, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g., Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude) and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate delivery
* Build relationships with internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals beyond a single customer engagement
* Drive creation of application and technical design documents that leverage Salesforce best practices and integrate Salesforce into customer infrastructure
* Troubleshoot key implementation issues and drive them to resolution; lead evaluation of business/technical requirements at a senior level
* Proactively identify and manage risk areas through to complete resolution
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with customers and third-party partners
* Contribute to Services Practice growth by leading internal strategic initiatives, mentoring junior teammates, and enriching technical/non-technical knowledge for customers and colleagues

****Minimum Qualifications****

* 2+ years as a Lead Developer doing solution design in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated leadership driving organizational transformation in a matrixed org
* Experience with enterprise architecture areas: integration technologies, single sign-on, master data management
* Experience with Waterfall and/or Agile methodologies
* Self-starter with proven results leading customer/partner success across front- and back-end architecture, development, release management, and change management
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Skilled at guiding customers and colleagues in adopting emerging technologies that drive business value
* Polished speaker able to evangelize best practices at various organizational levels
* Genuine interest in studying new technologies and pushing the limits of existing ones
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, tailored to the audience
* Strong presentation skills — able to present and defend a point of view to varied audiences
* Willingness to travel to client sites (avg. 25%, may vary by engagement)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or related field

**Certifications**
Helpful to have Salesforce.com product certifications before joining. Expected to earn these within the first 3 months:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Agentforce Service Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Consultant
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

****Preferred Qualifications — Leadership Qualities****

* Passion: Passionate about customer success
* Beginner's Mind: Always learning, open-minded, a great listener, hands-on
* Thought Leader: Strong point of view and executive presence — confident, not arrogant, a great storyteller
* Urgency: Moves fast and drives business value and results
* Ohana: Embodies Aloha culture — a team player with a generous heart
* Trust: Trusts the company's core values
* Adaptable: Excels amid high uncertainty and change

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

title: SALESFORCE DEVELOPEMENT MANAGER
description:
**Job Description & Requirements:**

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**SALESFORCE DEVELOPEMENT MANAGER**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Manager to lead the Salesforce platform, manage ongoing enhancements, and work closely with business and technology teams to deliver effective Salesforce solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the Salesforce platform, ensuring stability, performance, security, and continuous improvement.
* Lead Salesforce implementation, enhancement, and integration projects from requirements through delivery.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and central technology teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* Manage Salesforce configuration, workflows, automation, reports, dashboards, and user access.
* Lead integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications and platforms.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions and technical specifications.
* Manage and prioritize the Salesforce enhancement backlog based on business priorities.
* Coordinate with development, QA, architecture, security, and other central teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Monitor platform performance, data quality, security, and compliance.
* Establish and maintain Salesforce best practices, governance, documentation, and release management.
* Manage production issues, troubleshoot problems, and ensure timely resolution.
* Support Salesforce users through training, guidance, and effective change management.
* Manage external Salesforce vendors and partners where required.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce automation, AI, and new platform capabilities to improve business processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of Salesforce experience, with experience in a lead or managerial role.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.
* Experience with Salesforce configuration, automation, security, reports, and dashboards.
* Experience managing Salesforce integrations with other enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, APIs, and integration concepts.
* Experience managing Salesforce projects and working with Agile teams.
* Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional and central technology teams.
* Good understanding of Salesforce governance, release management, and platform best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Administrator
* Salesforce Advanced Administrator
* Salesforce Platform App Builder
* Salesforce Platform Developer
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Application Architect or related certifications.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 15+ years of experience working on the Salesforce platform, with 4+ years in a people management or team lead role
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL**
* Deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, data model, and security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules)
* Experience with Salesforce integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools)
* Experience managing Agile/Scrum development processes (sprints, backlogs, retrospectives)
* Strong understanding of CI/CD tools and DevOps practices for Salesforce (Copado, Gearset, AutoRabit, or similar)
* Excellent communication skills able to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

**Key Skills**

* Technical: Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, API integrations, Salesforce DX
* Leadership: Team management, mentoring, performance management, hiring
* Process: Agile/Scrum, release management, change management
* Soft skills: Stakeholder communication, strategic thinking, problem-solving

**Success in the Role**

The Salesforce Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Salesforce remains a stable, scalable, secure, and business-focused platform, while continuously identifying opportunities to improve user experience, automate processes, and enable new business capabilities.

title: VP Client Relationship Servicing
description:
**Job Title: VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**
CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done.
  
  
Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.
  
  
The role holder is equally accountable for the end-to-end client experience across CACS journeys: owning the process from first touch to completion, removing handoffs and delay between teams, and driving a continuous reduction in service SLAs/turnaround times - so clients experience a single, fast, joined-up service rather than a series of disconnected steps.
  
  
The role holder will oversee the general operations of the function including, but not limited to, financial planning/resource management, governance frameworks, digital implementation/adoption, performance management (OKRs, KPIs, SLAs), and stakeholder engagement, whilst additionally leading on ad-hoc initiatives as they arise to ensure the effective and efficient delivery of the function’s strategy and desired client outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. title: Manager, Workday Functional
description:
Mivada is a certified Workday Partner, and our work goes well beyond implementation. We help organisations rethink how they run HR and Finance on Workday.
  
  
This is a role for an accomplished Workday HCM leader who wants to run a portfolio, not just a project. You will direct multiple HCM streams, own the commercial outcome, build long-term client partnerships, and grow the next generation of Workday leaders in a fast-growing global consulting firm.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As Workday HCM Functional Consulting Manager, you oversee the delivery of multiple HCM streams or a mid-sized portfolio of client engagements. You are accountable for governance, client engagement, financial performance and people leadership. You work with Workday Leads, Solution Architects and client executives to deliver excellent, profitable outcomes and long-term partnerships, and you coach the leaders who will come after you.
  
  
What success looks like
  
  

* You direct multiple HCM streams or projects, balancing delivery, financials and risk.
* Client executives trust you for portfolio-level advice and direction.
* Your engagements land on scope, budget and timeline and hit profitability targets.
* You mentor and grow Workday Leads and senior consultants into future leaders.
* Your client relationships lead to renewals, expansions and long-term partnerships.

What you will be doing
  
  
***Delivery***

* Oversee multi-stream Workday engagements, keeping functional, technical and integration tracks aligned.
* Define delivery frameworks and oversee project charters, governance plans and risk frameworks.
* Sponsor cutover planning and adoption at portfolio level.
* Provide executive delivery oversight on high-profile issues and escalations.

***Client engagement***

* Partner with client senior managers and executives to shape and monitor HCM roadmaps.
* Lead executive-level governance sessions and quarterly business reviews.
* Manage client escalations and drive resolution diplomatically.
* Identify opportunities for further transformation work.

***Consulting mindset***

* Align solutions and delivery approaches with the client's strategic objectives.
* Promote continuous improvement and efficiency across delivery.
* Drive adoption of newer Workday capabilities (Extend, Prism, Automation) where they add value.
* Feed market trends into new Mivada service offerings.

***People and collaboration***

* Allocate resources across engagements, balancing utilisation, growth needs and delivery demands.
* Mentor Workday Leads so they can take on larger portfolios.
* Coordinate with Sales, Solutions and Data practices to keep delivery efficient across practices.
* Build a collaborative, high-performance culture across teams.

***Commercial and quality management***

* Own P&L responsibility for your assigned portfolio or engagements.
* Track portfolio KPIs: margin, utilisation and client satisfaction.
* Apply governance and audit standards consistently.
* Capture lessons learned and apply them across the practice.

**Requirements**

* Extensive hands-on Workday HCM Functional Consulting experience, with a record of leading multi-stream or multi-project delivery.
* Proven track record delivering Workday HCM implementations across multiple modules, including post-go-live support.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery financials, such as P&L, margin and utilisation, in a consulting environment.
* Experience advising senior client stakeholders and executives, including leading governance forums and managing escalations.
* Experience managing, coaching and developing consultants and leads, including offshore teams.

Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:

* Opportunities to be more for yourself and others

**Who We Are**
At
**Mivada**
we believe that when you bring technology and the right people together, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
  
  
Mivada is a high-growth technology consultancy, headquartered in Australia, offering services to both high-growth, mid-sized and global blue chip clients. Our flexible approach and strong reputation have led to repeat work and growth.

We operate as a team, supporting and learning from each other and we genuinely care about our clients’ success. Our Leaders are accessible, humble, and sometimes pretty funny! We like to enjoy our time at work, which means we encourage each other to shoot for the moon!

* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Associate Director, EAS Observability Product & Delivery Lead drives business application adoption of DTCC's observability capabilities, enabling Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), Enterprise Application Support, and Client Operations, Application Development teams to deliver more reliable, resilient, and efficient business services. The successful candidate will work closely with business application teams and key engineering stakeholders to drive adoption of observability services, influence product direction through customer feedback, lead delivery execution through an agile squad, and scale observability capabilities that enhance service reliability, accelerate operational excellence, and support DTCC's evolution toward AI-enabled operations. Through this leadership opportunity, the candidate will play a critical role in shaping how developers, Site Reliability Engineers, Application Support Engineers, Client Operations teams, and technology leaders leverage observability to improve service reliability, accelerate problem resolution, and enhance the stability of DTCC's mission-critical financial services ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Customer Engagement, Adoption and Value Realization- Own the customer relationship lifecycle from intake and discovery through delivery, adoption, and outcome review.
  
  

* Guide application teams to the appropriate service-catalog offerings and drive successful consumption of approved observability services.
* Translate observability capabilities into measurable operational, reliability, productivity, and customer outcomes; track adoption, utilization, value, and onboarding friction.
* Represent EAS Observability with business-unit and application stakeholders, ensuring engagements align with established observability priorities, standards, and strategic objectives.

Product Ownership and Delivery- Translate customer needs and strategic priorities into product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
  
  

* Own and prioritize the squad backlog using business value, enterprise priorities, risk, dependencies, capacity, and technical input.
* Lead Agile delivery activities with the Scrum Master and technical leads; coordinate cross-functional execution and actively manage risks, decisions, impediments, and dependencies.
* Provide concise, decision-oriented reporting on roadmap execution, adoption, delivery health, risks, and outcomes.

Service Catalog and Self-Service- Operate and continuously improve the observability service catalog as the primary customer engagement and service-consumption mechanism.
  
  

* Standardize intake, onboarding, documentation, enablement, and support to move suitable services toward repeatable self-service consumption.
* Convert recurring needs and onboarding friction into backlog improvements, reusable patterns, automation, documentation, and enablement materials.
* Lead organizational rollout and adoption of approved new services, products, and features.

Capability Design and Governance Alignment- Contribute customer, product, delivery, and adoption perspectives to service and feature design.
  
  

* Translate business needs into product requirements, and work with the observability squad to introduce new capabilities, features, and service improvements that increase customer value and adoption.
* Remain informed of new products and features, assess customer and catalog impacts, and coordinate rollout after direction and design decisions are established.
* Align delivery with approved observability standards, technology controls, operational-readiness expectations, and applicable risk, compliance, and audit requirements.

People and Squad Leadership- Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, including a Scrum Master and assigned developers.
  
  

* Mature Scrum Master capability across facilitation, delivery discipline, transparency, impediment management, metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Set clear goals and accountability, provide feedback and development support, delegate effectively, and foster an inclusive, outcome-oriented engineering culture.

Qualifications- 10+ years of related experience in technology product ownership, product management, delivery, engineering, platform operations, business analysis, or a comparable field.
  
  

* Proven ownership of technology products or services from stakeholder discovery and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and influence skills in complex, cross-functional, and cross-regional organizations.
* Significant delivery experience in financial services, fintech, capital markets, banking, or another highly regulated, mission-critical environment.
* Experience leading direct reports and cross-functional Agile teams, including coaching Scrum or delivery-management capability.
* Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into customer journeys, prioritized work, adoption plans, and measurable business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience- Observability, monitoring, reliability engineering, SRE, platform engineering, production support, or operational resilience.
  
  

* Metrics, logs, traces, alerting, APM, synthetic monitoring, SLI/SLO practices, and operational dashboards; exposure to Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, Open Telemetry, or comparable technologies.
* Technology service catalogs, standardized onboarding, automation, self-service, platform migration, cloud transformation, or modernization programs.
* CSPO, PSPO, or comparable products or Agile certification.

Talents Needed for Success- Business-value orientation and strong customer leadership.
  
  

* Product judgment, execution discipline, and clear priority management.
* People leadership, coaching, delegation, and accountability.
* Technical curiosity and effective partnership without displacing technical authority.
* Enterprise mindset, risk awareness, and concise executive communication.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with internal departments such as Academics, Marketing, Operations, Product, and Finance to resolve issues affecting AEP performance and student onboarding.

**Team Management**

* Lead a team of 4–5 Sales Associates, providing direction, performance monitoring, coaching, and development support.

Students
