title: Lead Consultant - Client Services (Oracle Cloud EPM Planning)
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Argano is seeking a EPM Planning Consultant for our Client Services practice. A consultant in Argano Managed Services is an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM professional responsible for sustaining, optimizing, and continuously improving clients’ production environments after go-live. The consultant manages a portfolio of client priorities, provides functional and technical leadership, and guides incident resolution, service requests, enhancements, and process improvements. Working collaboratively with client stakeholders, the Consultant helps protect operational stability, increase adoption, and deliver measurable business value. The role also mentors other consultants, contributes to reusable practices, and supports strong client satisfaction and long-term account success.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Argano Managed Services helps clients sustain, optimize, and continuously improve their Oracle Cloud environments after go-live. Our consultants combine functional expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and proactive client service to improve business processes and the end-user experience. We value creativity, teamwork, accountability, continuous learning, and a healthy, respectful workplace.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for Oracle Cloud EPM Planning
* Manage multiple client workstreams and service priorities concurrently, balancing incidents, service requests, enhancements, recurring activities, and planned initiatives against agreed priorities and service commitments.
* Act as a functional expert as part of a team and/or independently with no supervision.
* Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders. Keep all parties informed about progress, challenges, and changes.
* Collaborate with clients to understand evolving business objectives, operational challenges, and Oracle EPM needs. Assess existing configurations, usage patterns, recurring issues, and business processes to identify opportunities to stabilize, automate, optimize, and improve user adoption.
* Maintain current knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM monthly updates and relevant Oracle roadmap developments. Assess client impact, communicate recommendations, and identify opportunities for optimization and innovation.

**Education**
MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience, including significant experience supporting and enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud environments after go-live, with prior full-lifecycle implementation experience preferred to demonstrate a strong understanding of application design and downstream impacts.
* Expert knowledge of the Oracle Planning Cloud tools required.
* Hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, configuring, or enhancing Oracle Planning Cloud modules such as Workforce, Capital, Projects, Profitability and Cost Management, or Strategic Modeling.
* Strong Essbase calculation script writing skills preferred
* Experience with Groovy Scripts preferred
* Experience with Oracle EPM Data Exchange or Data Management, including troubleshooting data and metadata loads, mappings, integrations, validation failures, and recurring load processes.
* Experience with EDM a plus
* Experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud a plus
* Candidate should be teachable with a strong desire to learn and expand current knowledge base
* Professional services experience in an Oracle Cloud EPM Managed Services, application support, or production-operations role is strongly preferred; experience advising client stakeholders at a strategic level is also beneficial.
* In-depth knowledge of the relevant technologies and systems.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
  

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
* Service Delivery Management: Prioritize and coordinate concurrent client needs across incidents, requests, recurring operations, and enhancements while maintaining clear ownership, realistic commitments, accurate status, and alignment with service levels.
* Continuous Improvement: Translate recurring issues, service trends, Oracle Cloud updates, and industry practices into practical recommendations that improve stability, efficiency, controls, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Strong commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Strong degree of initiative, accuracy, efficiency, and attention to detail.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.

**About Us**
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.
  
  
Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.

**About the job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well-being, Google provides support for any non-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. description: Job Description: State Business HeadLocation: Hyderabad Markets: Kerala, Gujarat, Odisha (3 positions available) Experience: 7–12 years Compensation: 35–40 Lakhs per annum Reporting To: Founder's Office About the RoleThis role is for entrepreneurial State Business Heads who will build the business in their respective states almost like a Mini CEO. This is not a traditional marketing, operations, or business-development role. You will own the entire state business end-to-end: understanding the customer, identifying the right offerings, building partner networks, creating the occasion calendar, launching campaigns, acquiring customers, delivering the service successfully, and bringing customers back again. The ideal candidate possesses strong commercial thinking, cultural understanding, marketing instinct, and exceptional execution capabilities. What You Will OwnState Business & RevenueOwn the growth of the business in the assigned state. Build annual and quarterly business plans covering: Revenue, Transactions, New customers, Repeat customers, Average Order Value (AOV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Retention, Product portfolio, and Partner network. Treat the state as your own business and continuously identify new opportunities for growth. Understand the State's Consumer EcosystemDevelop a deep understanding of the state's key markets, regional traditions, festivals, seasonal and occasion-led demand, local customs, consumer preferences, life-event needs, influential local voices, and customer behaviour. Translate this understanding into products and campaigns relevant to customers in that state. Build Partner NetworkIdentify and develop relationships with high-potential partners and institutions. Responsibilities include: Partner discovery, meeting partner management and key stakeholders, partnership negotiation, offering selection, commercial arrangements, operational readiness, content collection, quality standards, and long-term relationship management. Build a strong pipeline of partners rather than depending on only a few. Build the State Occasion CalendarCreate a 365-day calendar for the state identifying opportunities around major festivals, monthly occasions, seasonal peaks, and other high-demand days. For every major occasion, decide the offering, partner, pricing, target customers, and marketing timelines. Product CreationWork with partners, product, content, and operations teams to create compelling offerings. Own the product proposition, partner selection, packages, pricing, add-ons, fulfilment, personalisation options, customer communication, photos/videos, storytelling, and landing-page proposition. Convert regional occasions into compelling and authentic consumer propositions. Campaign Planning & GrowthOwn the commercial success of every major campaign spanning Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion, creative testing, audience segmentation, landing-page conversion, remarketing, and WhatsApp marketing. Analyse campaign metrics to optimize propositions, partners, pricing, and creatives. Influencer & Creator PartnershipsBuild a state-level network of regional influencers, YouTubers, Instagram creators, regional celebrities, niche content creators, and community voices. Develop performance-linked partnerships that drive transactions rather than mere brand awareness. End-to-End Service ExecutionOversee the complete customer journey from booking, order detail collection, partner coordination, and service execution, to proof/video delivery, fulfilment, customer communication, and feedback. Retention & Repeat BusinessBuild repeat behaviour by working with CRM and retention teams across WhatsApp, push notifications, email, personalization, festival reminders, past-purchase recommendations, partner recommendations, cross-sells, family occasions, birthdays, anniversaries, and recurring purchases. Consumer InsightsConstantly analyse customer feedback, search behaviour, customer support conversations, campaign comments, social media, competitor actions, and market trends to launch new products and improve existing offerings. Candidate ProfileThis role calls for builders rather than administrators. The ideal candidate: Has 7-12 years of experience. Has built or scaled a consumer business, category, city, region, or marketplace. Understands digital consumer acquisition and Meta/Google performance marketing. Has strong commercial, analytical ability, and experience working with vendors, partners, or distributed supply. Can manage complex operations, understand retention/repeat purchase behaviour, and work with ambiguity to build things from zero. Possesses very high ownership and operates without waiting for instructions. Is comfortable traveling across the assigned state. Preferred Background: Experience in D2C, e-commerce, marketplaces, food delivery, travel, matrimony, consumer internet, regional content, or other high-frequency consumer businesses. Cultural RequirementDeep cultural understanding of the respective state is mandatory. The candidate must: Speak the state's language fluently and read it comfortably. Understand regional traditions, festivals, consumer behaviour, and cultural nuances across different districts/regions within the state. Note: All positions will be based in Hyderabad.

The role aligns stakeholder needs with BSI capabilities, facilitates cross-functional collaboration, and ensures priorities are translated into actionable plans and delivered through appropriate teams.
  
  
The Manager combines stakeholder management, governance oversight, operational planning and continuous improvement to ensure transparency, accountability, and value realization. The role helps drive alignment between market priorities and BSI resources while supporting the adoption of Golden Standard Solutions, operational excellence initiatives, and AI-enabled ways of working.
  
  
Working closely with regional and country stakeholders, CLS, BSI teams, DDIT, Finance, and other cross-functional partners, the Manager contributes to improved customer satisfaction, stronger governance, operational efficiency, and successful delivery of business priorities.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key responsibilities:**
**Market & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a primary pint of contact for assigned markets, regions, and above-country stakeholders.
* Gather, prioritize, and coordinate business requests through structured demand governance processes.
* Facilitate collaboration across BSI, CLS, DDIT, Finance, and partner functions.
* Ensure stakeholder needs are understood, addressed, and routed to the appropriate teams.
* Support issue resolution and monitor stakeholder satisfaction with delivered solutions.

**Demand Governance & Prioritization**

* Support demand intake, prioritization, and tracking across BSI service areas.
* Ensure requests are evaluated and aligned with business priorities, resource availability, and strategic goals.
* Maintain visibility of demand pipelines, resource requirements, risks, and dependencies.
* Support governance forums and decision-making processes.

title: Payroll Vendor Manager, Amazon Global Payroll team
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Payroll team within Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment. Our mission is to pay employees accurately and on time, every time, whilst keeping our costs controlled and complying with all regulatory requirements. The Amazon Payroll team is looking for an energetic, enthusiastic relationship manager with outstanding analytical, negotiation, and project management skills to join our Vendor Management team.
  
  
The Payroll Vendor Manager is responsible for payroll vendor selection, and vendor management across all countries. This position will help oversee the performance of payroll service providers (vendors) and keep all agreements current. The incumbent is required to build strong relationships with Legal, Finance Operations, Tech, Compliance, HR, and regional payroll operations teams.
  
  
This broad role is not only a relationship management role, it also focuses on Operational Excellence by partnering with Lean Six Sigma Black Belt team members to support continuous improvement of Amazon processes, aligning them with customer requirements, and delivering positive impacts in controllership, quality, and cost savings. This role may expand beyond the payroll space to support internal partners in FinOps and HR as needed. This position will initially have no direct reports.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Supporting the management of payroll vendor selection.
* Supporting market research activities.
* Supporting the negotiation and maintenance of contracts, ensuring reduction of cost per pay slip and alignment with Amazon's compliance and control requirements.
* Assisting and participating in vendor meetings as required.
* Analyzing and developing vendor performance data to support vendor governance.
* Analyzing vendor cost and cost improvement opportunities, monitoring monthly spending patterns, and identifying exceptions and areas for potential improvement.
* Deep diving customer pain points in a country and making recommendations for scalable solutions.
* Responding to escalations in a timely manner
* Supporting continued development of materials, techniques, and metrics to identify opportunities to improve VM tools, systems, and processes.
* Building and maintaining knowledge management tools such as wikis and shared drives.
* Training and mentoring stakeholders in vendor-related processes.

**Key Skills Required**

* Experience in payroll, HRO, or BPO services, account management, process improvement, procurement, contract negotiation, and creation. Ability to invent and simplify processes, adopt AI tools to drive efficiency, and willingness to learn the payroll cycle and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Communication, problem-solving, process improvement, stakeholder management, negotiation skills, and experience leveraging AI tools for operational improvement.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of vendor management, or 3+ years of relevant discipline work experience
* 3+ years of data analysis work and leveraging analytics to make decisions experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Experience with advanced use of Excel and using statistical analysis applications, or experience in vendor management
* 3+ years of vendor management, or 2+ years of relevant discipline work experience
* 3+ years of experience in vendor management, procurement, contract negotiation, or account management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payroll operations
* Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
* Experience delivering Lean/Six Sigma projects such as Kaizens, Greenbelts, and continuous improvement initiatives, this should include needs assessment, business case creation, scope definition, project planning and project implementation
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan
* Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
* Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
* Experience with end-to-end project management, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
* Experience building and scaling knowledge management systems (wikis, runbooks, shared repositories).

**About Us:**

DataBeat, a MediaMint company, is a specialist in the media and analytics space, providing end-to-end managed services for publishers (such as digital news networks) and ad tech platforms to scale their revenue and expand audience reach.

Positioned at the crossroads of technology, data, and digital media, our AI-first approach transforms complex advertising data into intelligent, revenue-generating decisions, we leverage cutting-edge AI and advanced analytics to power automated problem-solving, smart optimization, and data-backed decision-making across all core functions.

DataBeat Consulting is seeking to hire for the role of a Digital Media Lead. We are looking to recruit enthusiastic talent and quick learners who could take up challenges. In this role, you will own responsibilities and master various skills – handling data, business decision making, project management, client communication & management and support DataBeat growth.

**Role:**

1. Acquire subject matter expertise in Media and Adtech space over a period to own revenue management on behalf of the client and be their trusted advisor
2. Maintain a cadence of regular meetings with clients to understand their roadmaps and priorities to proactively identify opportunities to grow the partnership beyond any initial deal
3. Lead multiple accounts and solve high complexity client problems
4. Manage a team of account managers and analysts (with the below responsibilities) in building client relationships, ensuring a successful partnership and great experience
5. Study the data, identify patterns, present insights, and make recommendations to support the client on business decisions
6. Extract relevant data from the tools and systems to be able to solve a business problem at hand o Traffic, optimize and manage campaigns in the ad server of Publishers
7. Own the reporting systems and needs (periodic or ad-hoc) of the client
8. Be a thought partner to the client outlining innovative solutions and drive revenue upticks Proactively resolve business and operational issues with clients
9. Interact/ address CXO-level audience and deliver impactful presentations/workshops
10. Being involved in Hiring, Training, in building and/or guiding teams in creating high-quality deliverables

**Skills:**

1. Experience in AdTech/Digital Media space. Hands on experience of programmatic concepts like UPR Optimization, Header Bidding, GAM)
2. Hands on experience in GAM, SSPs (Appnexus, Magnite, Openx etc), Header bidding optimization and various yield optimizations (like Ad-Refresh, Ad-blocking)
3. Have experience in client facing/management and team management role
4. Strong team player; Keen interest in mentoring and grooming team members
5. Strong analytical and data handling skills (expert-level knowledge on MS Excel)
6. Exceptional problem-solving skills, able to think logically and communication skills
7. Extremely detail-oriented and well-organized
8. Strong Communication skills (verbal and written)
9. Ability to work efficiently and effectively in a high-paced environment and under deadlines - Knowledge of various methods to analyze & present the data is a plus

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India Work hours: 4 PM - 1 AM or 5PM – 2 AM or 6 PM – 3 AM based on client requirement

Intrigued by a challenge as large and fascinating as the world itself? Come join us.

**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**

Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with
**ISO/IEC 27001**
standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.

description:

Truvit aims to streamline the patient journey by making it easier to discover, connect with, and manage interactions with healthcare providers. We are seeking a high-performing, result-driven 
**Doctor Onboarding Manager (Medical Alliances & Doctor Relations)**

**App**

* **City-Wide Doctor & Clinic Onboarding:**

* **Relationship Management & Doctor Retention:**

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
   
  **3 to 5 years**

* **Preferred Background:**
   Prior experience with diagnostic networks, health-tech doctor platforms, or pharma/healthcare organizations or major pharmaceutical/diagnostic firms that are based out in Hyderabad

* **Education:**
   Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Healthcare Management, Pharmacy (B.Pharm), or Business Administration (MBA preferred).

* **Track Record:**
   Proven history of building strong physician networks, closing doctor partnerships, and driving business volume/referrals.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with doctors, Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and clinic administrators.

* In-depth understanding of diagnostic test menus, IV therapy protocols, and home nursing workflows.

* Closing-oriented mindset with high comfort in daily field travel and cold-calling clinics.

* Strong technology adaptability to demonstrate mobile applications (TruDoc App) seamlessly.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive 
  **Fixed Base Salary**
  .

* High-earning 
  **Performance-Based Commission & Monthly Referral Incentives**
  .

* Direct exposure to executive leadership and rapid career growth within an expanding health-tech brand.

**How to Apply**

📩 Send your resume to sushmith@stratbhargava.com or connect with us on WhatsApp at 9912320204  with the subject 
**"Application: Doctor Onboarding Manager - Hyderabad"**

title: Technical Engagement Lead
description:
The Role

You'll own a portfolio of existing client accounts, reporting to a Sr Account Manager. Your job is to run each engagement — requirements gathered, scope signed off, work delivered, the client's team trained and using it — landing on the committed date and at the quality bar the client expects, every time, while stewarding your accounts' ongoing migrations. You coordinate the analysts and a cross-functional team on each engagement without reporting lines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership, early.

This role is a designed transition: within two quarters you move into an FDE or AM seat — the landing is decided with the leadership team based on where you've demonstrated the most strength. The move is part of the role's design, not a contingency.

The Bar

Client satisfaction is the top priority for this role, achieved through delivery excellence — project management and technical quality. Every engagement lands on time and at the quality bar clients expect, the client genuinely well taken care of throughout, and the work actually put to use — and the measure is whether the client ends the engagement a promoter: someone who'd recommend Saras unprompted.

What You'll Own

1. **Land every engagement on time and at the quality bar clients expect.**
   No quietly cutting corners to hit a deadline.
2. **Run the full cycle — requirements to sign-off and adoption.**
   Gather business requirements, get explicit sign-off on scope and success criteria, deliver the work, train the client's team to actually use it, and confirm it's being used.
3. **Build a delivery sprint plan that leaves no room for ambiguity.**
   Every cross-functional team member knows exactly what success looks like for their task — ownership, success criteria, and dates that mean something.
4. **Keep the client genuinely well taken care of.**
   Clear communication, no surprises, and the hard conversations handled directly and calmly when something's off track.
5. **Coordinate the analysts and cross-functional partners on each engagement — without reporting lines.**
   Catch problems early, remove blockers before they impact deadlines, and escalate deviations directly to leadership the moment a commitment is at risk.
6. **Steward your accounts' ongoing migrations.**
   Keep them moving on schedule, and keep the client confident through them.

What Winning Looks Like

**First 90 days:**
You've picked up the delivery cadence on your accounts, you know the book and the state of every migration cold, and you know exactly where each engagement stands against its committed dates and quality bar.

**Steady state:**
Every engagement you own lands on the agreed date, at the agreed quality bar, the client can point to it being used, and your clients would recommend Saras — and by the end of quarter two you've demonstrated the strengths that decide your FDE or AM landing.

Who Thrives Here

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you've run multiple full cycles of requirements gathering, sign-off, and usage.

* You've managed technical delivery or implementation projects — data, analytics, software, or systems — from requirements through go-live, for 5+ years.
* You're comfortable working hands-on with SQL, either Tableau or Power BI, or data pipelines — enough to manage the delivery credibly and speak the team's technical language.
* You've held client conversations about scope, value, or renewals — enough commercial footing to see how delivery becomes revenue.
* You've conducted product or platform trainings directly with clients — comfortable being the face of adoption, not just the person who ships the work.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

* Hands-on experience building AI agents using tools like Claude Code to improve delivery efficiency.
* You've built production-grade dashboards as React-native web apps, using AI-assisted development.
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent project-management credential.
* Experience in pre-sales at an analytics or consulting firm (2+ years).

The Role needs experience of leading teams responsible for building or managing full application stacks from the system (Linux or Windows) up through a custom application, managing part of a network from layer 3 and higher, or web-related programming that includes the consumption of web services we’d like to talk with you!

You will leverage your broad experience to work closely with sales leadership to plan and ensure successful launch and operations of AWS’s largest application workloads. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

* 4+ years of technical team management experience
* 5+ years of direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C-level) experience
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, or a related field
* Experience in technical team management
* Experience in direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C-level)
* Experience working with enterprise software companies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience driving projects to improve support-related processes and technical support
* Experience in systems administration, network engineering, or software development engineering

title: Head of Institutional Partnerships & Programme Manager
description:
**About MB Learning**

MB Learning designs and runs educational immersion programmes for Indian schools — study trips, summer schools and learning journeys in India and abroad with partner universities. Founder-led, headquartered in Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Small team, real responsibility from day one.

**The role**

This is the senior Hyderabad role at MB Learning, combining two jobs: building relationships with schools, and making sure every programme we sell is coordinated end to end. You will meet principals, coordinators and counsellors, present our programmes, and then run the follow-through — reminders, documents, payments, parent communication and the travel team — so nothing is lost. With the Founders often travelling, you are the person who holds Hyderabad together.

**Key facts**

• Compensation: Rs 50,000 – 75,000 per month gross based on experience, plus performance incentives on programmes closed

• Type: Full-time employment · 6-month probation

• Experience: 3 – 8 years in school partnerships, admissions, counselling, education sales or programme coordination

• Location / hours: Gachibowli, Hyderabad (office-based) · Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

• Start: Immediate / October 2026 · reports to the Founders

• Travel: Accompanies student groups on selected programmes in India and abroad

**What you will do**

• Build and manage relationships with schools in Hyderabad and beyond (CBSE, ICSE, IB and Cambridge): principals, coordinators, counsellors and management.

• Present MB Learning programmes in school meetings and parent sessions; take enquiries through to signed confirmations.

• Work with sales and partners: track every lead and school in the CRM, send reminders and make sure follow-ups happen on time.

• Coordinate each confirmed programme across the team — proposals, travel desk, finance, marketing — against a clear timeline.

• Chase student registrations, documents and payments with schools and parents; keep them updated before and during the trip.

• Travel with student groups on selected programmes as MB Learning’s lead on the ground; report weekly to the Founders on pipeline and collections.

**What we need from you**

• Excellent spoken and written English; confident presenting to principals and parents.

• Proven experience dealing with schools or education institutions — an existing network in Hyderabad schools is a strong advantage.

• Highly organised; follows up relentlessly and keeps several programmes moving at once.

• Able to travel with student groups for 5–10 days at a time a few times a year; based in Hyderabad.

Good to have: Study-abroad or school-excursion background · Former school coordinator or counsellor · Telugu and Hindi · Valid passport.

**How to apply**

Apply on LinkedIn, or email admin@mblearning.in with your CV and a short note on the schools or institutions you have worked with. Subject: “Head of Institutional Partnerships & Programme Manager – [Your Name]”. Questions: +91 88888 44666.

Process: first conversation with the Founders (virtual, 30 min) → in-person round in Gachibowli (mock school pitch + coordination case) → offer. Equal-opportunity employer. We never charge a fee at any stage of hiring.

title: Agentforce Success Architect - AMER Shift
description:
**Description**
At Salesforce, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued. We believe that the unique perspectives and skills of diverse candidates greatly contribute to the success of our teams. As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving successful outcomes for our strategic customers by leveraging your technical expertise in data and analytics.
  
  
Data Cloud supports seamless integration with Salesforce Marketing, Sales, and Service Clouds, enabling Customer 360 use cases. This ensures that businesses can unify customer data across all touchpoints, enhancing AI-driven marketing automation, personalized engagement, and predictive customer insights. By powering hyper-personalized experiences and real-time decision-making, Data Cloud helps organizations maximize customer lifetime value and drive business growth.
  
  
Additionally, Data Cloud is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. By leveraging Data Cloud, Agentforce can deliver context-aware AI automation, hyper-personalized customer interactions, and predictive insights, driving greater operational efficiency and business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Be a trusted Agentforce + Data Cloud subject-matter expert for the broader Success Architect organization, including how Data Cloud relates to the success of AI
* Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, dev/ops, performance, and solution design specific to Agentforce + Data Cloud
* Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative Architect solutions through customization
* Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI
* Run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, tailored to the unique needs and opportunities of Agentforce + Data Cloud customers
* Build strong relationships with both internal and external business partners, contributing to broader goals and growth
* Drive thought leadership through mentoring and knowledge sharing
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Your Impact**
As an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have a significant impact on our customers' success and the growth of our organization. Your expertise and guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers, ensuring their success in leveraging Agentforce + Data Cloud's powerful data capabilities. By driving customer satisfaction and delivering exceptional value, you will contribute to the overall growth and reputation of Salesforce as a leader in the industry.
  
  
**Collaboration and Team Work**
Collaboration is at the core of our success, and as an Agentforce + Data Cloud Success Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with diverse teams of professionals. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions. By fostering strong relationships and working collaboratively, you will contribute to the collective success of our teams and the achievement of our goals.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 8 years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Analytics/CDP spaces
* Minimum 2 development/project implementation lifecycles of Salesforce Data Cloud/CDP + AI
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes focusing on data & integration architecture, with a focus on guiding customers through migration to and optimization of Agentforce + Data Cloud
* Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices
* Excellent communication skills, and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams from Developer to Executive
* Ability to facilitate discussions and translate technical concepts & solutions into tangible business value and ROI for customers
* Ability to demonstrate basic understanding and stay up-to-date with emerging data-related and AI technologies
* Proactive and self-starting attitude with the ability to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely with customers and colleagues
* Values the importance of Data Ethics and Privacy by ensuring that customer solutions adhere to relevant regulations and best practices in data security and privacy
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. proven behaviors in previous jobs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a consulting.implementation Partner for Data Cloud/CDP
* Experience with large data such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Storage/Big Query, Azure administration or architecture
* Experience with Customer Data platforms such as Segment, Tealium, Adobe Experience Platform, Amperity, Treasure Data, Twilio Segment, Realtio, etc

* Familiar with at least one of the Salesforce Architecture Domains: Integration, Access and Identity Management, Data Architecture, Sharing and Visibility, Declarative and APEX Development

**Note:**
This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.
  
  
**Shifts -**
Candidate should be comfortable working in AMER shifts (6:30 PM - 3:30 AM) as well.

title: Market Development Manager - Biopharma
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape the Future of Biopharma Innovation in India**
Agilent Technologies is seeking a strategic, customer-focused, and results-driven
**Market Development Manager, Biopharma**
to accelerate growth across one of the world's fastest-growing biopharmaceutical markets.
  
  
India is rapidly emerging as a global hub for biosimilars, biologics, CDMOs, advanced therapeutics, and pharmaceutical innovation. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence industry direction, shape market strategy, build strategic partnerships, and drive business transformation initiatives that create long-term competitive advantage.
  
  
This position sits at the intersection of science, business, and strategy, working closely with customers, industry leaders, academia, government agencies, and cross-functional Agilent teams to identify growth opportunities, execute strategic initiatives, and accelerate market adoption of Agilent's solutions.
  
  
This is a
**single contributor role**
with significant cross-functional influence and accountability for driving outcomes through strong stakeholder engagement, project leadership, and execution discipline.
  
  
**Most importantly, this is an execution-focused role. Success will be measured not by opportunities identified, but by business outcomes delivered. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution discipline, data-driven decision-making, and relentless project follow-through to ensure initiatives translate into measurable impact.**
**Job Description:**
**Drive Market Growth & Strategic Development**

* Identify emerging opportunities across biologics, biosimilars, peptides, oligonucleotides, ADCs, cell and gene therapy, and other advanced therapeutic modalities.
* Develop and execute market development strategies that accelerate revenue growth and expand Agilent's presence across India's biopharma ecosystem.
* Conduct continuous market intelligence gathering, including customer feedback, competitive assessments, market trends, regulatory developments, investment activities, and emerging technologies.
* Develop robust market monitoring processes, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms that enable data-driven decision making.
* Translate market insights into actionable growth initiatives, investment recommendations, and commercial strategies.
* Serve as the voice of the market by identifying unmet customer needs and emerging opportunities before competitors.

**Lead Strategic Collaborations & Partnership Programs**

* Establish and manage strategic collaborations with leading biopharma companies, CDMOs, CROs, research institutions, universities, industry associations, government agencies, and innovation ecosystems.
* Lead collaboration projects from concept through execution, ensuring alignment of objectives, stakeholders, timelines, resources, and expected outcomes.
* Develop collaboration roadmaps and governance structures to maximize business impact.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), scientific leaders, and senior industry decision-makers.
* Convert strategic collaborations into scalable commercial opportunities, customer references, workflow adoption programs, and long-term partnerships.

**Drive Business Transformation & Commercial Innovation**

* Lead strategic business transformation initiatives that improve customer engagement, organizational effectiveness, and growth.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative Go-to-Market (GTM) models that improve customer coverage, workflow adoption, market penetration, and business performance.
* Develop channel strategies, customer segmentation frameworks, territory coverage models, and resource allocation recommendations to maximize growth opportunities.
* Build data-driven investment cases and business proposals that support new growth opportunities, organizational changes, and capability development.
* Partner with leadership teams to design and implement transformative initiatives such as dedicated biopharma channels, workflow-led selling models, partnership ecosystems, and new commercial structures.
* Shape future business strategies by identifying structural gaps and recommending scalable solutions that enhance customer experience and commercial effectiveness.

**Lead Execution & Deliver Results**
This role requires exceptional execution capability and project leadership.
  
  

* Establish clear project objectives, KPIs, milestones, governance mechanisms, and success metrics for strategic initiatives.
* Own project tracking and performance monitoring to ensure initiatives remain on schedule and deliver intended outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across commercial, marketing, applications, business units, and leadership teams.
* Proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, escalate issues when necessary, and maintain momentum across complex initiatives.
* Hold stakeholders accountable and ensure commitments are translated into action.
* Develop executive updates and progress reviews to provide visibility into project performance and business impact.
* Foster a culture of execution excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**The successful candidate will be known for making things happen. They will relentlessly push initiatives forward, connect strategy to execution, and ensure that projects move beyond discussion and planning into measurable results.**
**Enable Commercial Success**

* Support strategic account planning and opportunity development across key biopharma customers.
* Partner with sales, applications, and marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth and market adoption.
* Provide market expertise and workflow insights to strengthen customer engagement strategies.
* Champion a One Agilent approach across strategic customer accounts and growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in biopharma, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare technology, business development, market development, strategic marketing, consulting, or related fields.
* Strong understanding of India's biopharma ecosystem, including biologics, biosimilars, CDMOs, CROs, and emerging therapeutic modalities.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Our Legal Business Services Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) practice is expanding its Application Managed Services team (AMS). As a CLM AMS Portfolio lead/Manager within the Application Managed Services (AMS) Team, you will manage multiple AMS projects within the CLM practice, ensuring client requirements are met and service levels are consistently maintained or exceeded. you will play a pivotal role in leading teams to deliver high-quality support, drive continuous improvement, and ensure the success of our clients’ business-critical applications throughout their transformation journey.
  
  
You will oversee and mentor cross-functional teams, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and foster strategic client relationships to deliver exceptional service. Your responsibilities include managing escalations, overseeing client communications, ensuring adherence to SLAs, and identifying opportunities for innovation and process optimization at scale. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and client management skills, along with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
As a CLM AMS Portfolio Lead/Manager, you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of way, including:
  
  
**Client Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders, building trusted advisor relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Prepare and present regular status reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to answer questions about the features and capabilities of our product.

**Delivery**

* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.

* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.

**People Development**

* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.
* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.

As legal operations and contracting specialists, we help clients make appropriate operations and technology choices. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operations services.
  
  
Deloitte TTC-LBS professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s Legal Business Services team helps clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operating models. Learn more about Deloitte Legal Business Services.

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* 6+ years of experience in CLM System configuration, application management, system support, or technology consulting, with CLM platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft, etc.).

Icertis certified ICI Administrator, Icertis Certified Functional Professional, Sirion Certified CLM Specialist)

title: Complaints Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We’re looking for a new Team Lead to work with our teams based in Hyderabad to join our mission! Along with our other Complaints Team Leads you’ll be responsible for looking after the needs of our Complaints Officers, as well as working with our product and compliance teams to rectify systemic issues so we can continue to scale and grow. If you’re passionate about people and want to extend your skills into the realm of project management, risk assessment, and generally being part of something amazing and fast-paced, then this role is for you!
  
  
As a Complaints Team Lead at Wise, you will be instrumental in ensuring that our customers receive exceptional service and that their concerns are addressed promptly and effectively. Your primary purpose will be to execute a robust complaints management strategy that aligns with regulatory standards and supports our commitment to transparency and customer satisfaction.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team of Complaints Officers, providing guidance, coaching, and support to ensure that all complaints are handled efficiently and in accordance with established procedures. By analysing complaints data and identifying underlying trends, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives aimed at addressing root causes and enhancing our overall customer experience.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams and influence the development of products and processes to minimise complaints and optimise customer outcomes. You will also serve as a key point of contact for regulatory inquiries and audits related to complaints management, demonstrating Wise's commitment to compliance and operational excellence.
  
  
Ultimately, your role will be critical in shaping Wise's reputation as a customer-centric organization that values transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in resolving customer concerns globally.
  
  
Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and mitigating potential risks associated with complaints management, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and implementing risk-mitigation strategies to safeguard Wise's reputation and operational integrity.
  
  
**What activities does a Complaints Lead undertake?**
**Management and Leadership**

* Own the performance of your team and deliver departmental KPI's that enable the Complaints function to be successful.
* Develop talent mapping approaches that help identify everything from future talent that requires nurturing to current gaps within the performance of your team.
* Remedy any performance gaps utilising the relevant people policy as a guideline.
* Develop and implement training programmes to enhanced skills and capabilities of Complaint Officers, ensuring consistency in handling customer complaints across regions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on complaints management during cross-functional projects, providing guidance on best practice and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain a proactive approach to risk management, identifying emerging trends and potential issues and help deliver strategies to mitigate risks associated with complaints.
* Ensure regular communication is maintained with the team through effective team meetings and town hall attendance.
* Hire in line with company policy when there is a need to scale the team further.
* Doing things better
* Continuously evaluate and enhance the operational delivery of complaints, as per the strategy, to drive improvements in performance, customer experience and compliance.
* Suggestion innovative solutions and best practice to reduce complaint resolution times and enhance the overall quality of responses to customer concerns.
* Using data and analytics, identify recurring issues and root causes of complaints leading to targeted process improvements and service enhancements.
* Champion a customer-centric approach to complaints handling, advocating for proactive communication.
* Help create and maintain a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging experimentation and knowledge sharing to drive innovation.

**Customer Experience Enhancement**

* Executive strategies and initiatives to enhance customer experience through effective complaints resolution and proactive management.
* Implement feedback loops to capture customer insights and integrate them into initiatives that support service improvement and product development.
* Act as the voice of the customer from a complaints perspective, ensuring that you make a valid contribution to efforts that gravitate around improving our customer's service experience.

**Continuous Professional Development**

* Stay current with industry trends, best practice and emerging technology in complaints management.
* Pursue professional development opportunities such as certifications, workshops and conferences related to customer advocacy and complaints management.

**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring:**

* Operational & Analytical Mastery: Proven history of leading front-line operations teams to achieve challenging KPIs. Skilled in setting clear OKRs, streamlining processes, and using data to solve root cause issues.
* Team Leadership & People Management: 2+ years of direct management experience building and scaling high-performing teams. Passionate about talent growth, coaching through feedback, and cultivating a positive team culture.
* Change Navigation: Skilled at leading teams through operational changes and structural pivots while keeping team morale high and raising execution standards.
* Strategic Stakeholder Influence: Clear, persuasive communicator who builds strong working relationships and constructively challenges existing norms when needed.
* Accountability & Ownership Mindset: Highly autonomous leader who owns team results end-to-end, fights for the customer experience, and leads with humility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing or collaborating with cross-border, international teams.
* Fintech, payments, or banking background, particularly with experience working alongside Product and Engineering teams.
* Prior experience leading customer support escalations, disputes, or complaints management functions.

Additional Information
  
  
**Additional Information**
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Territory Business Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
The role is accountable for sales targets & delivery, ensuring timely collections, driving DG, and overseeing product liquidation in the assigned territory. The role requires effective market penetration, distributor and retailer management, and strong channel engagement while ensuring seamless execution of sales strategies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead DG, ensuring liquidation targets while acting as a knowledge hub on crop, pest, competition, and farmer practices for their territory.
* Work on segmentation, targeting, positioning, and preseason planning, ensuring execution of liquidation strategies.
* Drive sales through distributors and retailers, ensuring market penetration, share growth, and service excellence. Track distributor/retailer performance vs. POs, manage collections, and reconcile accounts.
* Monitor and consolidate product movement from distributor to retailer to farmer, ensuring accurate reporting of liquidation, inventory, and sales data.
* Strengthen distributor/retailer relationships, implement national programs, enforce trade discipline, manage stock returns, and communicate pricing and schemes.
* Liaise with KVKs, government agencies, and Agri. Dept. officials to drive local coordination.
* Work closely with ZDCLs & ZBMs for seamless execution of DG activities and regularly update the sales team.
* Collaborate with the NC team to identify hotspots and connect farmers to VPDs.
* Supervise key DG activities, including farmer meetings and field days, ensuring strong market engagement.

**Activity Plan Breakdown**

* Retail Servicing & Territory Planning (50%) – Ensure effective retail engagement, optimize territory coverage, and drive sales through planned servicing (13 days).
* Distribution Management (10%) – Strengthen distributor relationships, ensure stock availability, and streamline inventory operations (3 days).
* DG Delivery & Supervision (30%) – Oversee DG initiatives, ensure execution excellence, and drive farmer engagement (8 days).
* Reporting, Planning & Meetings (10%) – Track progress, analyse data, and align with teams for strategic decision-making to create comprehensive territory channel & sales strategy (3 days).

**Qualification, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's / Master’s Degree in Agriculture.
* 3 to 5 years’ experience in agro-input industry.
* Good communication -oral and written- in both English and local language.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Capability to achieve sales targets, by still retaining control on the market.
* Strong commercial acumen, understanding of the margin structure, conceptualizing schemes and articulating the advantages of our margins and schemes to the retailers and Distributors.

title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Love football (soccer) and have an entrepreneurial mindset?
  
  
Stranger Soccer is expanding across key cities worldwide and is seeking a License Owner to launch and grow the Stranger Soccer operation in Hyderabad.**
**This is not a salaried management role—it's an opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual to build and operate something of their own while making football more accessible in their local community. We're looking for someone ambitious, community-driven, and passionate about the game.**
**Does This Sound Like You?**
Visit
**www.strangersoccer.com**
and explore the
**"Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City"**
section to learn more.
  
  
If this opportunity aligns with your goals, complete the interest form to start the conversation. We also recommend downloading the Stranger Soccer app to experience the platform firsthand.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Launch and grow the Stranger Soccer brand in Hyderabad
* Recruit, train, and manage a small local team (2-3 people), supported by Official Hosts
* Secure suitable football venues and regular playing opportunities
* Drive marketing and customer growth through digital and local initiatives
* Oversee game operations while delivering an outstanding player experience
* Work closely with Stranger Soccer HQ, supported by established operations and technology teams

**What We're Looking For**

* Passion for football and strong connections within the local football community
* Experience in management, operations, sales, or customer-facing roles
* An entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently
* A strong sense of ownership and ambition to grow Stranger Soccer locally
* Motivation to deliver results, with rewards tied to performance and growth

**About Stranger Soccer**
Football is loved by billions, yet many still struggle to play regularly. Stranger Soccer makes playing football as easy and convenient as going for a jog or visiting the gym.
  
  
Our app lets players discover nearby games, book a spot, and simply turn up to play.
  
  
Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates across 10+ cities and has delivered over 100,000 games worldwide. We're looking for passionate License Owners who want to bring this experience to their communities—whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or football.
  
  
**Our Mission**
To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.
  
  
**Our Vision**
A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.
  
  
**Ready to be part of the journey?**
We'd love to hear from you.

At
**ModMed**
, we place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform. We envision a world where our software increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes. As the
**Manager, Support Services**
