title: Operations Fulfilment Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 AdOnMo is one of India's largest and fastest\-growing Out\-of\-Home (OOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors like Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a vast and expanding network of 33,000\+ digital screens (outside lifts) and 20,000\+ static frame posters (inside lifts) across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our ad formats are installed in high\-visibility public locations, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Cult.fit gyms
* Goa beaches
* Shopping malls
* Bike parking areas with branded standees and digital hoardings



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping them build real\-world visibility through innovative and targeted outdoor advertising campaigns.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Operations Fulfilment Manager to join the Acumen team and take ownership of the fulfilment journey end\-to\-end.
 



 The role will involve coordinating closely with production, warehouse, installation, Operations and Customer Success teams to ensure orders move as planned, timelines are met, and client escalations are resolved effectively.
 



 The ideal candidate should be organised, dependable, hands\-on, and comfortable working across multiple teams, with strong ownership of execution and follow\-through.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience: 3\+ years



  





  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* *1\. Own Fulfilment End\-to\-End*
* Track every order from production and dispatch through delivery, installation and go\-live.
* Maintain complete visibility on the status of every open order.
* Ensure orders progress through each stage as planned and are successfully closed.



  




* *2\. Drive Coordination and Timelines*
* Work closely with Production, Warehouse, Installation, Operations and Customer Success teams.
* Identify potential delays and bottlenecks early.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure orders move as planned and timelines are met.



  




* *3\. Own Client Escalations*
* Take complete ownership of client escalations related to fulfilment.
* Communicate clearly and calmly with stakeholders.
* Drive issues through to closure and ensure that escalations do not remain unresolved.



  




* *4\. Keep the Team and Process on Track*
* Support the existing Operations team in managing day\-to\-day fulfilment activities.
* Maintain a simple, accurate and up\-to\-date order tracker.
* Follow up on pending actions and ensure clear accountability for every next step.
* Maintain visibility on pending orders and ensure timely follow\-ups.



  




* *5\. Identify and Improve Recurring Issues*
* Identify patterns and recurring challenges in the fulfilment process.
* Proactively highlight issues to leadership.
* Suggest practical process improvements to reduce recurring fulfilment challenges and improve operational efficiency.



  





  





  





**Required Skills** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Operations, Fulfilment, Client Delivery, Service Delivery or a similar role.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end fulfilment or delivery processes.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to work across multiple teams.
* Experience handling client/stakeholder escalations and driving them to closure.
* Strong follow\-up and execution skills.
* Comfortable maintaining trackers, monitoring pending actions and managing multiple orders simultaneously.
* Ability to identify operational challenges and suggest practical solutions.
* Highly organised, dependable and hands\-on approach to work.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in a similar Operations, Fulfilment, Service Delivery, Client Delivery, Logistics, Installation or Project Execution role would be preferred.



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 AdOnMo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 The role is responsible for building strong stakeholder relationships, conducting regular business and service reviews, proactively identifying risks and early indicators of client dissatisfaction, and driving corrective actions before issues impact retention. The CSM serves as the voice of the client within ADP while representing ADP's capabilities, strategy, and product roadmap to clients.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is protecting and growing recurring revenue through effective renewal management, client engagement, and identification of upsell and cross\-sell opportunities that align with client business needs. The CSM is expected to leverage insights into the client's organization, workforce strategy, and technology environment to uncover opportunities for expansion, optimization, and innovation. The role also drives continuous improvement by analyzing service performance, identifying operational inefficiencies, and coordinating actions across both ADP and client teams to improve service quality, business outcomes, and overall client experience.

title: Lead – Supply Chain Operations & Customer Experience
description:
This is precise because it names both functions the role actually owns (not a generic "founder's office" or "chief of staff" label that pulls in unrelated generalists), and it's the exact phrase candidates with real supply chain/ops \+ CX experience search for and apply against.
 



  





 If you can spot where a business is leaking, understand why, and build the fix, this role is for you. Direct founder access, full business context from day one, and real accountability for outcomes across two critical functions CX and Operations.
 



  





**1\. Customer Experience \& Retention** 



* Own the post\-purchase journey end to end — from first delivery to repeat purchase, including re\-order nudges, win\-back campaigns, loyalty mechanics
* Track cohort repeat rates, time\-to\-second\-order, churn triggers, and NPS by product/channel via a weekly retention dashboard
* Own CX metrics as performance targets CSAT, first response time, resolution SLA, repeat complaint rate, NPS, repeat purchase rate, refund/return rate
* Write, own, audit, and update the CX SOP library complaint handling, delivery delay resolution, escalation matrices, agent playbooks
* Run RCA on every recurring failure trace root cause, fix the source, update the SOP, verify the fix held
* Feed CX insights upstream to inform NPD, formulation, and supply chain decisions
* Own the CX tech stack ticketing, WhatsApp automation, logistics webhooks



  





**2\. Supply Chain \& Operations** 



* Own the Operations SOP library procurement, inbound QC, CMO coordination, warehouse, dispatch, returns
* Drive SOP adherence through floor\-level checks and exception tracking
* Run RCA on operational failures (batch rejection, delivery delay, procurement gap) and verify fixes over 2\-3 cycles
* Own the CMO performance scorecard on\-time delivery, batch quality, rejection rates, CoA compliance
* Own inventory planning reduce OOS without creating excess stock or working capital lock\-in
* Own 3PL coordination — NDR management, RTO reduction, SLA adherence, exception\-handling SOPs



**3\. Business Intelligence \& Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Build founder dashboards as early\-warning systems, not rear\-view mirrors
* Track retention\-led revenue metrics — cohort repeat rates, refund/return trends, complaint\-to\-churn correlation, fulfilment SLA impact on NPS
* Own cross\-functional projects from intake through prioritisation, execution, and closure



**Must\-have:** 



* 1\-8 years post\-qualification experience in consulting, operations, supply chain, a founder's office, or a high\-ownership role at a D2C/FMCG/consumer startup (Tier 1 consulting or early startup particularly valued)
* Independently builds data models and turns complex operational problems into crisp recommendations
* Has built SOPs from scratch, run RCA when they broke, and closed the loop at root cause
* Comfortable moving between strategic framing and ground\-level execution
* High ownership orientation accountable for outcomes, not just outputs



**Strongly preferred:** 



* CX operations with a retention/revenue lens cohort tracking, post\-purchase engagement flows, loyalty programme impact
* Hands\-on procurement or vendor management with CMOs or RM/PM suppliers
* Shopify, Freshdesk/Zoho Desk, Shiprocket, Klaviyo, advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL or data viz a bonus

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
**Description**
 The Global Accounts Receivable (GAR) Customer Experience team exists for one reason: make sure every customer interaction with Amazon's AR function is so good it strengthens the relationship and accelerates revenue collection. We do this across 8 business channels and 9 support centers worldwide, building smarter processes, better communication, and technology that scales.
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior CX Manager who can turn that mission into results. You'll lead the AR customer experience function across some of Amazon's largest and fastest\-growing business channels: AWS, Amazon Business, Retail, Advertising, and Transportation, ensuring every AR touchpoint with customers and vendors meets a high bar. You'll do this through a globally distributed team of Customer Experience Specialists, and you co\-own the global CX metric with Operations, which means you're accountable for what customers actually experience, not just what's planned on a slide.
   

  

 This is a people\-leadership role at its core. You'll manage across time zones and cultures, coach CX Specialists into independent problem\-solvers, and build mechanisms that work when you're not in the room. But you also need to be hands\-on with data, comfortable pulling apart CX trends, building root\-cause models, and presenting findings to senior leaders who expect clarity and a point of view.
   

  

 You'll need to design scalable automation (partnering with FinTech and FinAuto), deploy ML\-powered sentiment detection, and build self\-service tools that reduce manual effort. If you're energized by operating in a high\-growth, high\-ambiguity environment where you have to invent the playbook, this is the role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Will Include, But Are Not Limited To**
 CX Strategy \& Metric Ownership
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end CX quality across assigned businesses, driving measurable year\-over\-year improvement in defect rates and customer response quality
* Define the annual CX roadmap: balance quick wins that move the needle this quarter with structural fixes that compound over time


 Automation \& Technology
   

  

* Partner with FinTech, FinAuto, and Data Engineering teams to design and deploy solutions that reduce manual touchpoints: zero\-touch email responses, intelligent case routing, automated root\-cause tagging
* Drive adoption and improvement of ML\-powered negative sentiment analysis to proactively flag and resolve customer concerns before they become escalations
* Own the rollout of next\-generation communication and feedback management tools that improve first\-contact resolution rates and shrink resolution time


 Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Be the CX voice in cross\-functional forums. Influence upstream teams to fix root causes, not just symptoms, of customer friction
* Partner with Tech and Operations leadership to align on priorities, share data, and unblock execution
* Plan and deliver global CX Summits and Vendor Experience forums that drive mechanism adoption and build a culture of customer obsession across support centers


 People Leadership
   

  

* Manage, develop, and inspire Customer Experience Specialists across the globe — each with distinct operating rhythms and cultural contexts
* Set clear goals, provide regular coaching, and create development paths that grow your team's analytical depth, stakeholder presence, and ownership
* Build a team culture where data\-backed experimentation, dive deep, bias for action, and customer obsession are the default


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology or equivalent, or a Bachelor's degree and experience or equivalent experience in finance roles
* 
* 10\+ years of professional experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Program Management, or a related analytical role
* 
* 5\+ years of people management experience, including managing geographically distributed teams
* 
* Track record of driving measurable improvements in customer experience or service quality metrics at scale
* 
* Strong data fluency — ability to build business cases, interrogate complex datasets, and translate findings into action\-oriented narratives for senior leadership
* 
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects with competing priorities, providing escalation management, and making trade\-offs
* 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to work in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* 
* Experience in Accounts Receivable, Order\-to\-Cash, or Finance shared services environments
* 
* Hands\-on experience with Voice of Customer (VoC) programs, sentiment analysis, and NPS\-driven improvement cycles
* 
* Background in root\-cause analysis and continuous improvement methods (Six Sigma, Lean, or similar)
* 
* Experience presenting to and influencing VP\-level leadership on CX strategy and investment decisions
* 
* Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (SQL, Excel, Tableau, or equivalent)

Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and delivery\-focused Team Lead to manage end\-to\-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business\-as\-usual operations.
   

  

 The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
   

  

 Why this role is important to us
   

  

 The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day\-to\-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
   

  

 The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low\-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
   

  

 What you will be responsible for
   

  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market\-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non\-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead\-account, match\-rule, workflow, and static\-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go\-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open\-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit\-ready.
* Oversee post\-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational\-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker\-checker controls, information\-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross\-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating\-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.


 What we value
   

  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment\-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market\-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT\-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end\-to\-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people\-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder\-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit\-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive\-reporting skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical and operational matters into clear decisions, actions, and status updates.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on delivery quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and working knowledge of project\-tracking, workflow, data\-visualization, and process\-documentation tools.


**Education And Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 or more years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Prior experience leading a team, workstream, or complex implementation within a high\-volume, global operating environment.
* Practical expertise using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.
* Experience managing relationships with custodians, investment managers, fund administrators, technology teams, and global operations stakeholders.
* Experience managing implementation risks, testing governance, production readiness, stabilization, and operational handover.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience with JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, or related workflow and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Agile or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Demonstrated involvement in automation, system enhancements, process transformation, or operating\-model improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing management information, capacity views, performance metrics, and executive\-level project updates.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully\-billable, high\-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.

You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation \& ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.

You will own the executive\-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.

You will champion an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross\-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C\-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high\-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at\-risk customer environments.
* Cross\-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi\-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre\-sales \& delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well\-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well\-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.

description:

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

**Salesforce Customer Success**
 Salesforce’s worldwide Customer Success team is a global network of Salesforce employees and partners. Our sole mission is to ensure customer success. We work with our customers to build relationships, learn about their businesses, and drive value\-based results. Our motto for our customers is "Your Success is our Success"
   

  

* Job Description: Senior Success Archiect/Success Architect


**Role Description**
* Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long\-term business success.
* Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long\-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long\-term success.


**Key Responsibilities**
* As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:
* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs.
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI\-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive\-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi\-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI\-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C\-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI\-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership


**Basic Requirements**
* Solution Design \& Architecture
+ 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience
+ Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
+ Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles.
+ Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
+ Familiarity with industry\- or vertical\-specific solutions (preferred).

* Communication \& Leadership
+ Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
+ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
+ Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
+ Proven ability to manage customer\-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
+ High proficiency in English.

* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
+ Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
+ Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
+ Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
+ Desired Technical Skills

* Sales Cloud Expertise
+ Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management.
+ Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.

* Data Management \& Integration
+ Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master\-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
+ Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third\-party connectors.

* Secure \& Scalable Architecture
+ Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
+ Ability to review a customer's security model for common issues.
+ Skilled in identifying common anti\-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution.

* Salesforce Development
+ Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
+ Hands\-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting.
+ Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.

* System Integration \& Extensibility
+ Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
+ Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.
+ Certifications

* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer\-facing role, with hands\-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI\-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI\-generated insights into executive\-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI
* Required: Salesforce Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant
* Desired: Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can

 NowFloats is focused on improving local online discovery for small and medium businesses by structuring their information so it can be easily found by nearby consumers. Using a patent\-pending “location\-based SEO” process, the company helps businesses appear prominently in local search results. NowFloats offers both an organic discovery model with automated search engine optimization and a hybrid model that combines organic reach with paid marketing tools such as Google Ads and Facebook ads.  We are looking for an experienced Customer Support \- Enterprise Customers to deliver a high\-quality support experience to our enterprise and multi\-location customers. You will be responsible for helping customers successfully use the platform, resolving complex queries, driving product adoption and ensuring every interaction reflects a high standard of customer experience. This is more than a ticket\-resolution role\- you will own the customer experience from problem identification to resolution.

 ● Manage the end\-to\-end support experience for enterprise and multi\-location customers through calls, chats, emails and support tickets.

 ●
 
 Support customer onboarding, implementation and product adoption.

 ● Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 



 ● Strong customer relationship and stakeholder\-management skills.

 ● Comfortable handling customers through calls, email, chat and ticketing platforms.
 



 ● Good understanding of SaaS/web\-based products, dashboards and digital platforms.
 



 ● Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 ● Ability to manage multiple customers and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 ● Strong ownership, follow\-up and escalation\-management skills.
 



 ● Customer\-first mindset with the ability to handle demanding customers professionally.

title: Associate Client Success Manager
description:
***You will build a success function for Saas Marketplace from scratch.***
 While this is exciting, we will be upfront: this role won't be easy. Zero to one is always difficult. There will be confusion and chaos. Of course, you will get help. We are in this together. But you have to decide if you are up for it, and that's what we'll test in our interactions.
   

  

 But do not apply if your primary motivation towards applying is a remote job. We are building a business here. So, we expect high ownership and proactiveness. And we mean it. Yes we are remote, but that should not be a criteria for application.
   

  

**Our platform:** 
 bizdeals.gonuclei.com (AWS drives our bulk of the business)
   

  

**Who are you?**
 We want to hear your story around the skills below.
   

  

* Extreme ownership: Do you know the book? Why are you interested in the retention part of the business? What drives you? How will you demonstrate ownership?
* Problem solving: As the first person on the retention team, there won't be set processes. You will co\-build with us. Observe the challenge, define the problem and probable solutions, and execute.
* Diligent and hard\-working: I mean it.
* Think you don't have a topic to discuss with the customer. Will they still spend 10 minutes on a call with you? If yes, you know how to transcend a professional relationship.
* Learnability: You will have to understand what AWS is and learn a few technical concepts. Think about what you've learnt in the last 6 months.
* Communication: Good energy, voice modulation, fluency in English and Hindi. We mean it.
* 1\-2 years of experience managing customers, any role would do. It's okay if you don't have relevant work experience, as long as you want to learn how to build something from scratch.


**Task**
 Bring a one\-pager before our first conversation, sharing your ideas on how to build a great success function. What should we do, what should we avoid? You're welcome to use AI to brainstorm ideas, but the write\-up itself
 ***should be in your own words***
 , not AI\-generated.
